requirements.RC-0065: Geçmiş bir tarih için transit hesaplanabilecek.
requirements.RC-0066: Gelecek bir tarih için transit hesaplanabilecek.
requirements.RC-0067: Transitlerin natal gezegenlere yaptığı açılar hesaplanacak.

invariants: Transit chart consumes explicit versioned ephemeris states at one TT instant and never uses device current time.
Historical and future transit support are the same deterministic explicit-instant calculation path, without date substitution or network fallback.
Natal and transit charts remain separate snapshots and comparison retains both natal and transit TT instants.
Transit-to-natal aspects are calculated from transit longitudes against fixed natal longitudes with the shared explicit orb policy.
Mixed transit instants, duplicate bodies, mixed provenance and natal/transit provenance mismatch fail closed.
